project_type: Next.js 14 App Router with TypeScript, 3D news network visualization
build_system: Next.js with bun (bun.lock present), npm scripts in package.json
test_framework: No test files found - verification is build-only
test_command: No tests exist - use build success as verification
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npx next build` to verify TypeScript compilation and no build errors. 2. Check that all new modules resolve correctly.
setup_instructions: node_modules already installed. Runtime available via `bun` at /root/.local/share/mise/shims/bun. Use `npx` for next commands.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode. bun runtime available. node_modules pre-installed. No test framework. Must create new branch from current feat/3d-overhaul state.
contribution_requirements: Create new branch feat/elegance-overhaul from current state of feat/3d-overhaul. Push and open PR against main.
key_patterns:
- All API routes in app/api/ use NextResponse, export `dynamic = 'force-dynamic'`
- Mock data in lib/mock-data.ts uses daysAgo() to fake freshness
- Store uses /tmp JSON files (ephemeral on Vercel)
- Hooks in lib/hooks/useApiData.ts fall back to mock data on API failure
- NetworkGraph uses react-force-graph-3d with custom Three.js nodeThreeObject
- Styling: Tailwind + custom glass/glass-strong classes in globals.css
- Framer Motion for page/component animations
- EconomicNode type in lib/types.ts defines graph node shape
- Graph data flow: app/api/graph/route.ts -> getGraphData() from store -> falls back to mockGraphData
directory_structure:
- app/ - Next.js App Router pages and API routes
- app/api/ - Server-side API endpoints (news, graph, analysis, predictions, cron)
- components/ - React components (NetworkGraph, NewsCard, DailySummary, PathwaySimulator, Sidebar)
- lib/ - Business logic (types, mock-data, news fetchers, AI modules, hooks)
- lib/news/ - News pipeline (fetcher, api-fetcher, store, sources, scheduler)
- lib/ai/ - AI modules (summarizer, relationship-extractor, pathway-analyzer, daily-summary-generator)
- data/ - Seed/fallback data directory (currently empty with .gitkeep)
- public/ - Static assets
